text:
jess: Quick proposal — add per-slab + per-shard eviction counters and an `eviction_origin` label to help attribute fragmentation vs age. Current telemetry hides the root cause.

kai: Can you sketch the metric schema and cardinality constraints? :thinking_face: 

jess: Sketch:
```
# low-cardinality counters
kv_eviction_total{shard="s0",slab="large",reason="age"}
kv_eviction_total{shard="s0",slab="large",reason="fragmentation"}
kv_residency_gauge{shard="s0",slab="large"}

# sampled/low-volume attribution (sent to logs pipeline)
kv_eviction_sample{shard="s0",slab="large",model_id="m-123"}

# histograms for age/latency
kv_eviction_age_seconds_bucket{shard="s0",slab="large",le="10"}
```
Keep `shard` and `slab` only — don't add model to high-card counters.

maria: +1 on keeping model_id out of main counters. We should emit sampled traces for model attribution. Logging pipeline can handle high-cardinality.

shreyas: I can mock dashboards. Proposed PromQLs:
```
# eviction rate per shard
sum(rate(kv_eviction_total[5m])) by (shard)

# residency ratio per slab
avg(kv_residency_gauge) by (slab)

# eviction origin breakdown
sum(rate(kv_eviction_total[5m])) by (shard, reason)
```

jess: Alert v1 ideas:
- Pager if `sum(rate(kv_eviction_total[5m])) by (shard) > 0.05 * instance_capacity` for 10m
- Warning if residency drops > 15% vs baseline
Rationale: sustained evictions indicate either poor slab sizing or KV fragmentation.

opsbot: deploybot created branch `jess/kv-metrics-proposal` and opened PR #4567 — CI passed :white_check_mark:

kai: Also let's expose a histogram `kv_eviction_age_seconds` so we can see if hot keys are being evicted prematurely.

maria: And add `kv_prefix_cache_hits` / `kv_prefix_cache_misses` counters — these show long-context growth behavior.

jess: Next steps: I'll land a minimal PR (counters + histograms) on staging, run 48h sample with sampling rate 1/100 for model_id. Then we can iterate on dashboard tiles and alerts.

shreyas: I'll add a Grafana mock: heatmap of residency over time + waterfall of eviction reasons. Slack me when PR is on staging and I’ll hook dashboards up.

opsbot: noted — tagging this thread in the perf sync agenda for Thursday.
